issues_for_decider.issue: ClaimReview schema 'claimReviewed' field (line 1513) uses '${counts.total}' (72 — our catalog count, including sub-entries) instead of '${failures.dome_claimed_confirmed}' (69 — what the dome actually claims). The claimReviewed field is supposed to state the claim being reviewed, i.e. the dome's own claim, not our entry count.
